blocks.title:
The paperwork,
in one page.
blocks.sub: What procurement asks before the first invoice: contracts, IP, data, security, insurance, invoicing. Placeholders are marked; we would rather show a gap than a badge.

blocks.title: Everything a buyer checks.
blocks.sub: Nine items. If yours is not here, ask on the call and we will add it to this page.
rows: Contracts

A master services agreement once, a two-page SOW per engagement. Thirty days’ notice either side, no minimum beyond the first three months on embedded work, no automatic renewal. Your paper or ours. [MSA TEMPLATE LINK]
Intellectual property
Yours on payment of each invoice. Code lives in your repository from day one; we keep nothing except what we have learned. Open-source licences used are listed in the handover pack.
Your data

We work in your cloud account under least-privilege access that you grant and revoke. No production data on laptops; no copies outside your estate; access removed at handover and confirmed in writing. For UK and EU clients we sign your DPA or supply ours. [DPA LINK]
Security practices

Two-factor authentication on every account, secrets in a manager and never in a repo, dependency scanning in CI, every change reviewed by a second senior, no shared accounts. Certifications: [NONE YET / LIST]; we will say so plainly rather than imply otherwise.
Where the work happens

Delivery in Lahore, Pakistan, with four hours of daily overlap with GMT (shifted for US teams and written into the SOW). Model and AI tooling runs through providers that do not train on your data, or inside your own cloud account; the SOW states which.
Insurance
Professional indemnity: [INSURER · COVER AMOUNT]. Certificate available on request.
Invoicing
Monthly in arrears for embedded work, per increment for built work. NET 14. GBP, USD or EUR by bank transfer. [VAT / TAX STATUS] · [BANK COUNTRY].
Subcontracting
None without your written consent. The engineers on your SOW are the engineers on your account.
The company
Hopsig Technologies, [LEGAL FORM], registered in Pakistan, [COMPANY REG NO.], established [YEAR]. Registered office: [ADDRESS].

blocks.title: What we ask of you.
aside: Three things, all in week one
rows: A named decision-maker
One person who can say yes to a scope and no to a change. Not a committee.
Access in week one
Repo, cloud account, board, and whoever owns the thing we are touching. Day ten is only possible if day one happens.
Fifteen minutes a fortnight
The review. Shipped, slipped, cost against plan. It is the whole governance model.

blocks.title: Send this page to procurement. Then book the call.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
blocks.emailLine: Or email [HELLO@HOPSIG.COM] — reply within one working day.
